gloss: being banned from a place; barred entry

definitions.gloss: being banned from a place, barred entry
definitions.explanation: A colloquial abbreviation of {出入|でい}り{禁止|きんし} (prohibited from entering and leaving). Means being permanently banned from a shop, restaurant, bar, or other establishment due to bad behavior.

examples.japanese: あの{店|みせ}を{出禁|できん}になった。
examples.english: I got banned from that store.

examples.japanese: {暴|あば}れたせいで{居酒屋|いざかや}を{出禁|できん}にされた。
examples.english: I was banned from the izakaya for causing a scene.

examples.japanese: {迷惑|めいわく}な{客|きゃく}は{出禁|できん}にするしかないと{店長|てんちょう}が{言|い}っていた。
examples.english: The manager said they have no choice but to ban troublesome customers.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{出禁|できん}になる (get banned)
・{出禁|できん}にする (ban someone)
・{出禁|できん}にされる (be banned)
・{出禁|できん}を{食|く}らう (get hit with a ban)

USAGE NOTES:
An informal abbreviation of {出入|でい}り{禁止|きんし} (lit. "entry and exit prohibited"). Widely used in casual conversation and online. The full form {出入|でい}り{禁止|きんし} is used in more formal or official contexts. Can also be used in gaming contexts to mean being banned from a server or community.
